model_annotation: Figure 5 presents two line plots illustrating training dynamics for different LLM compression methods on the GSM8K-CoT dataset: (a) Loss versus training steps, and (b) Loss ratio versus FLOPs. In plot (a), the x-axis represents training steps on a linear scale from 0 to 1.4×10⁵, while the y-axis shows loss values ranging from 0 to 1.5. Four lines are plotted: Vanilla (black, solid), StrmLLM (n=256, red, dashed), SepLLM (n=64, green, dash-dotted), and SepLLM (n=64,H/T, blue, dotted). All lines show a decreasing trend in loss over training steps, with Vanilla starting at ~1.3 and ending near 0.7, StrmLLM starting at ~1.2 and ending near 0.65, SepLLM (n=64) starting at ~1.1 and ending near 0.6, and SepLLM (n=64,H/T) starting at ~1.0 and ending near 0.55. In plot (b), the x-axis represents FLOPs (in units of 10¹²) on a linear scale from 0 to 1.4, and the y-axis shows the loss ratio (relative to Vanilla) from 0 to 1.4. The same four methods are plotted with identical styles. All lines decrease as FLOPs increase, indicating improved efficiency. Vanilla remains at a ratio of 1.0 throughout. StrmLLM starts at ~1.0 and ends near 0.85, SepLLM (n=64) starts at ~0.9 and ends near 0.75, and SepLLM (n=64,H/T) starts at ~0.85 and ends near 0.7. Both plots include a legend in the top-right corner identifying each method by color and line style.
